prose:
Latent Space introduces a conversation with Thariq Shihipar about AI making software cheap to produce while also allowing more attention to individual design choices. The accessible description uses a game and a personal Dock experiment to contrast quantity of output with craft, and lists chapters on decision models, adoption and research.

Only the episode description and chapter list were readable, not the full fifty-four-minute discussion or transcript. Specific arguments, benchmark outcomes and practical instructions cannot be reconstructed from those headings. The description says Shihipar announced a move to OpenAI after recording, so the conversation should not automatically be treated as a formal OpenAI product announcement.
highlights: Game and Dock examples are introduced
Chapters include decision models and adoption
Move to OpenAI is described as announced after recording
No product availability or quantitative result is established
